run_PA_evaluation_single_gpu: run the single GPU test to evaluate part affinity proposals on a dataset using a checkpoint
run_PA_evaluation_multi_gpu: run the multi GPU distributed test to evaluate part affinity proposals across multiple GPUs
run_PA_with_OLN_ranker: run the PA evaluation using an OLN model for ranking generated mask proposals
test_PA_proposals_recall: test the PA module by generating proposals and computing recall against ground truth masks
review_PA_test_cli: review the test_pa CLI arguments for config, checkpoint, eval-proposals, fuse-conv-bn, and launcher options
